name: Group Compare - ComfyUI vs Pixaroma
description: Group Compare - ComfyUI vs Pixaroma is a lists & iteration workflow designed to demonstrate reusable list, loop, and value-carry patterns using the models configured in the graph. Its 7-node graph exposes 0 prompt/text field(s), 0 media input target(s), and 0 save/preview stage(s), while preserving the original editor-format graph for reference. The ComfyUI editor graph was converted to API format and is ready for live validation against the connected node and model registry.
instructions:
1. Open the workflow and select Validate. SineForge will compare every node class and input against the currently connected ComfyUI instance without queueing it.
2. Confirm that any model selectors in the editable inputs resolve to files available in the main ComfyUI installation.
3. No required media file was detected in the converted graph; begin with the prompt and generation controls.
4. Edit the positive/negative prompt, resolution, sampler, steps, guidance, and seed. Use a fixed seed while tuning composition, then vary it deliberately.
5. Save a copy before making structural changes. Use Editable inputs for normal parameters and Raw API JSON only when you need to inspect or change graph wiring.
6. Validate again after every change. Queue one workflow only after validation passes; then inspect the returned output, logs, duration, dimensions, and media integrity.

Add one: select nodes and press G, or right-click.", "fontSize": 13, "fontFamily": "Arial", "fontColor": "#c0c0c0", "textAlign": "left", "backgroundColor": "#333333", "padding": 10, "borderRadius": 0, "opacity": 1, "fontWeight": "normal", "lineHeight": 1.4}

{"text": "What the Pixaroma Group adds over a ComfyUI group:
- Separate title + body colours, each with its own opacity (a ComfyUI group has one flat colour)
- A node-count badge in the header (this one shows 2)
- Resize from ALL FOUR corners (a ComfyUI group resizes from the bottom-right only)
- Fold the whole group down to a slim bar: its nodes and wires tuck away to tidy the canvas
- Hover the header for one-click buttons: Run, Mute, Bypass, Fold, Colour
- Run just this group (queues only its output nodes); Mute / Bypass reach inside subgraphs
- Snaps into line with the Align tool, and groups can be nested inside each other", "fontSize": 13, "fontFamily": "Arial", "fontColor": "#c0c0c0", "textAlign": "left", "backgroundColor": "#333333", "padding": 10, "borderRadius": 0, "opacity": 1, "fontWeight": "normal", "lineHeight": 1.45}
